title: Adverbs of Possibility: talán, esetleg, hátha

sections.title: Nuances of Possibility Adverbs
sections.content: You know *talán* from A1 Unit 14 and *esetleg* from A2 Unit 27 (words on their vocabulary lists); *hátha* is new. *Talán* indicates moderate uncertainty ('perhaps, maybe'). *Esetleg* suggests a tentative alternative or condition ('possibly, if so'). *Hátha* introduces an optimistic or wishful possibility ('who knows, perhaps / in the hope that').

items.spanish: Talán érdemes lenne még egyszer átolvasni a szerződés feltételeit.
items.english: Perhaps it would be worthwhile to read through the contract terms once more.

items.spanish: Siessünk, hátha még elérjük az utolsó villamost!
items.english: Let's hurry, perhaps we can still catch the last tram!
